summary:
Building AI and data products for Bangladesh's power & energy sector.

- Designed and developed, with my team, **ESB PowerLine** (esbpowerline.com): a bilingual news and data portal covering power generation, grid, fuel & LNG, renewables, policy, tariffs and markets.
- Build data pipelines and analysis tools that collect and organise sector news and data from many official sources.
- Working on the upcoming ESB PowerLine monthly magazine on the power sector.

events.title: ESB PowerLine portal
events.tagline: Power & energy news and grid data, under one roof
events.body:
ESB PowerLine brings Bangladesh's power and energy sector together on one platform, with daily, sector-focused updates in English and Bangla.

**Coverage includes:** power generation, grid & transmission, distribution & utilities, oil, gas & LNG, renewable & alternative energy, energy policy & regulation, consumers & tariffs, energy markets, finance & investment, infrastructure & major projects, international & cross-border energy, environment & energy efficiency, and industry & technology.

The portal also has a live grid-data snapshot and a magazine section, with a dedicated monthly magazine coming soon.

*One sector. One platform. One roof.*
